newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police say catch fake priest with cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Italian police say catch fake priest with cocaine.

text.p: Italian police said on Thursday they had arrested an Englishman as he tried to smuggle four kg (nine pounds) of cocaine through Rome's Fiumicino airport while disguised as a priest.

Police said 56-year-old Anthony Unsworth, who had arrived on a flight from South America, wore a black suit and had a chain of rosary beads hanging from his pocket. He also had religious works and prayer books and was clutching a suitcase.

Police became suspicious and followed him to the departure gate. A search of his hand luggage showed he had cocaine with a street value of 10 billion lire ($6 million) hidden in the false bottom of his case, according to police.
